messages:
carmen: quick follow-up from the late-night incident — root cause appears to be a burst of identical queue timeouts on /v1/stream that blew past our alert fan-out rules. postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/pm/IN-4891. need to reduce noise and lock owners for remediation. proposed buckets: dedupe rules, threshold-based rate alerts, and paging policy tightening. who can pick these up?
leo: i'll take dedupe + suppression. plan is a 45s dedupe window grouped by route+model+error_signature. i'll draft the alert rule and add a smoke test that simulates back-to-back failures. target: PR by Tue noon, rollout Wed morning. example rule i'll add to infra-alerts: ```yaml
name: route_model_dedupe
dedupe_window: 45s
group_by: ["route","model","error_signature"]
```
tara: i'll own threshold replacement. instead of absolute counts, switch to poisson-based rate alert (errors per 1m normalized by request volume). will run this in staging for 72h, then evaluate false positive rate. target: staging config live Thu, review Mon. i'll also attach an Optimize eval to measure recall/precision on our labeled alert samples.
mike: paging policy needs tightening. proposal: only page if either (1) errors observed across >=2 AZs in a 10m window AND error rate spike >0.75% OR (2) SLO breach detected by ops signal. i'll update the oncall playbook and formalize an escalation matrix (oncall -> platform -> svc-owner). i'll coordinate the communication to the rotation team before rollout. target: runbook change Wed, announcement Thu.
pagerbot: Incident IN-4891 created by carmen  linked postmortem and notified #eng-oncall 2026-03-23T02:14:12Z
carmen: thanks all. summarizing owners/timelines: leo -> dedupe (PR Tue noon, rollout Wed AM), tara -> thresholds (staging Thu, evaluate Mon), mike -> paging/runbook (update Wed, announce Thu). i'll add weekly checkpoints for 3 weeks on Fridays 9am to monitor alert volume trends and catch recurrence patterns. also creating a follow-up ticket to add correlation telemetry between KV-cache misses and /v1/stream timeouts (IN-4905).
leo: i'll include unit tests + a quick-run simulation in CI to verify dedupe doesn't suppress unique errors. :white_check_mark:
tara: will create dashboards for false-positive tracking and a rollback threshold at 10% increase in missed true incidents.
mike: will update runbook and include a short decision flowchart. will also add a quick play to disable the new paging rule for a rotation if noisy.
carmen: great work. please update your issue when you push changes. we'll review aggregated metrics at the first checkpoint (Fri 9am)
